annotations.title: Check an image against Amazon main image rules

description: Checks one image (base64) against Amazon’s published main image rules: pure white background (RGB 255, 255, 255), product fills 85% or more, whole product in frame, no border, 500–10,000 px, zoom size, file type. Free; no account needed. Returns pass, warn or fail per check with the measured value.

image_base64.description: The image file as base64 (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP or TIFF), up to 15 MB
